title: Gibson SG Standard Custom Color, Cardinal Red Burst

long_description.title: Add Some Color to Your Life
long_description.body: The Gibson SG Standard rocks the classic looks and features associated with the late 60s style SG™ models sought after by many. Now featured as part of the Custom Color Series, it adds exciting new color options to liven up any stage or guitar collection. It features a rounded profile mahogany neck, bound rosewood fingerboard, long tenon 19th fret neck joint, and a solid mahogany body that provides the backbone for singing sustain. The 490R and 490T Alnico 2 pickups provide the power to drive. A black, 5-ply, full-face pickguard set this SG Standard apart from others... a truly versatile classic. A soft shell case is also included.

Neck Specs.Joint: Glued In, Long Tenon, Set Neck

Hardware Specs.Control Knobs: Black Top Hat with Silver Reflector

Misc Specs.Headstock Inlay: Gibson Logo and Crown in Mother of Pearl
